summary.text: Alberto Flores is the Democratic candidate for Arizona House of Representatives District 24 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the July 21, 2026 Democratic primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born in the district and listed lowering costs, public education and health care as his main priorities.

paragraphs.text: Flores earned a bachelor's degree from Arizona State University in 2025.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his degree is in political science and that his political activism began during the Arpaio era and the debate over SB 1070.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is the son of a working-class, mixed-status immigrant family and helped support his family by expanding their business as a teenager.
He said he supports stronger worker protections, fully funding public schools and more transparency for Empowerment Scholarship Account spending.
He listed endorsements from state Representative Anna Abeytia and state Senator Analise Ortiz.
